notes: Meta: 'Lazy Oaf create irreverent streetwear clothing for men and women, inspired by youth nostalgia, teenage rebellion and a spirit of non-conformity.' About: 'Founded by Gemma Shiel from a North London Garage in 2001'; started with hand-printed T-shirts sold from a stall in East London.
Shipping help: 'USA. Spend over $200 and get free shipping on your order.' Duties and taxes are calculated and paid at checkout for orders outside the UK (no charge on delivery).
Returns help: refund within 28 days of receiving the order (Oaflet items 14 days); exchanges UK only; returns not free: US from $19; returns go to its UK warehouse.
